Clotic (clotrimazole otic solution) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-741201  
Guideline Name 
Clotic (clotrimazole otic solution)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Clotic  
Approval Length 
1 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of fungal otitis externa (otomycosis) due to Aspergillus species or Candida 
species  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 353 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 353 
 
2 - Patient has an intact tympanic membrane, with no known or suspected tympanic 
membrane perforation  
 
AND 
 
3 - ONE of the following:  
 
 3.1 Trial and failure (minimum 14-day supply), contraindication, or intolerance to generic 
clotrimazole 1% topical solution (Rx or OTC)  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 Provider has provided a reason or special circumstance explaining why the patient is 
unable to use generic clotrimazole 1% topical solution (Rx or OTC) (please document 
reason/special circumstance)

Date  
Notes

New program.
